# v1.0.0 — PowerShell variant (launch issue reported)

A launch problem has been reported with this PowerShell-based version. For now, use the simple BAT version linked below.

## Recommended download

**[Download the simple BAT version for Windows — ZIP](https://github.com/Fsas12/flac-to-wav-dj/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)**

This download contains the BAT version currently documented in the repository. It is a different implementation from the v1.0.0 asset attached below.

## First conversion with the BAT version

1. Extract the ZIP linked above.
2. Download FFmpeg separately. On 64-bit Windows, use `ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip` from [Gyan's Windows builds](https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/). Extract it and copy `bin/ffmpeg.exe` beside `convert_flac_to_wav.bat`.
3. Copy 1–2 FLAC tracks directly into that same folder.
4. Double-click `convert_flac_to_wav.bat` and find the results in `wav`.

Original FLACs stay untouched. If an output WAV already exists, FFmpeg may ask to overwrite it; choose `N` to keep it. The simple BAT version has no automatic safe-skip mode, CSV logs, subfolder scanning, or selectable 24-bit mode.

**[Full instructions](https://github.com/Fsas12/flac-to-wav-dj/blob/main/README.md#quick-start)** · **[Инструкция на русском](https://github.com/Fsas12/flac-to-wav-dj/blob/main/README.ru.md#первый-запуск)**

## About the v1.0.0 asset

The attached `flac-to-wav-dj-v1.0.0.zip` and the source archives for this tag belong to the PowerShell-based version. The release asset has not been replaced. Its additional options are not features of the simple BAT version linked above.

Check the resulting WAVs in your intended DJ software or player before using them for a set. Preservation of all DJ metadata is not guaranteed.

[Report a problem](https://github.com/Fsas12/flac-to-wav-dj/issues/new)
